checks.input: Sample grip at 0–140 m/s in 0.01 m/s steps; compare every input-response setting with the approved kart.

checks.rule: Measured turn paths improve modestly rather than changing character

input.script: Start 90/130/180/220 mph on flat ground; Gas+full Right for 1.5 s, boost granted at 220; measure actual velocity-direction radius in the final .5 s.

checks.expected: New radius is 90–98% of approved radius, speeds differ by less than 1 mph; all four frame rates produce identical authoritative states and metrics.

checks.rule: A sideways disturbance settles slightly sooner without snapping velocity

input.script: Start forward 20 m/s with sideways 4 m/s, neutral controls for 2 s; observe first physics tick below .05 m/s sideways.

checks.expected: New settling occurs sooner but within 20% of approved time; no speed gain, no steering/yaw rotation, same state and time at each display rate.

input.script: For each speed 0/20/60/98.3488 m/s: Gas, boost, brake, lift, reverse phases over 6 seconds; compare every physics tick.

checks.expected: Every physical trajectory and speed matches the approved kart exactly; no changes to straight-line driving or caps.
